name: whisper-large-v3-turbo-arabic-dialectal
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.809 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-07-08. CAVEAT: 932-clip private held-out set the author built (oddadmix/dialectal-arabic-lahgtna-v2-smaller-augmented), not a public test split, so nothing here is leaderboard-comparable. The card labels the model private/internal. WER and CER were printed as fractions and are stored as percentages.

benchmarks.name: Dialectal Arabic held-out WER
benchmarks.config: Card 'Results (932-clip held-out test set)': this model 0.344 vs base whisper-large-v3-turbo zero-shot 0.590. Card prints fractions; stored as percent (x100). Lower is better. Dataset oddadmix/dialectal-arabic-lahgtna-v2-smaller-augmented, clean_text scoring.
